name: Arzdoon
author: Mohamad Jahani
description: Arzdoon shows live Iranian rial buy and sell rates in the Omarchy bar. Left-click the $ item for a compact table; use Show in Bar to pin selected sell prices on the bar itself. Middle-click or press R to refresh. If the source is unreachable, the last successful snapshot stays on screen. Settings pick the provider, refresh interval, and how many rates can appear in the bar.

barWidget.description: Live Iranian buy and sell rates, with optional sell prices in the bar.

schema.label: Price Provider
schema.description: More provider adapters can be added without changing the panel.
